say:1:1122109001:1.text: Capturng a baby terrabird? Just as I expected. This won't be a tough first job for you.
say:1:1122109001:1.source_cn: 要抓陆行鸟幼崽？果然和我想的差不多，没什么难度。

say:2:1122109002:1.text: Good! This bounty suits you perfectly, newbie.
say:2:1122109002:1.source_cn: 正好，这个委托很适合现在的你。
say:2:1122109002:1.male: Good! This bounty suits you perfectly, newbie.
say:2:1122109002:1.female: Good! This bounty suits you perfectly, newbie.

say:4:1122109003:1.text: W-what?! Giving such a simple task to one such as our magister is a complete waste of talent!!
say:4:1122109003:1.source_cn: 这么简单的任务，让主人去做简直是大材小用——！
say:4:1122109003:1.male: W-what?! Giving such a simple task to one such as our magister is a complete waste of talent!!
say:4:1122109003:1.female: W-what?! Giving such a simple task to one such as our magister is a complete waste of talent!!

say:6:1122109004:1.text: Not every job has to be intense treasure seeking! You can make money by doing small tasks like this. You gotta put food on the table after all.
say:6:1122109004:1.source_cn: 别说你主人了，即使是让老憨去做这份委托，也是浪费。
say:6:1122109004:1.male: Not every job has to be intense treasure seeking! You can make money by doing small tasks like this. You gotta put food on the table after all.
say:6:1122109004:1.female: Not every job has to be intense treasure seeking! You can make money by doing small tasks like this. You gotta put food on the table after all.

say:7:1122109005:1.text: And come now, I have better things to do with my time. This would be a waste even for Grayhorn, and he's, y'know... So times like this are when a newbie like you should step up!
say:7:1122109005:1.source_cn: 但是没办法。振奋人心的悬赏不是每天都有，还是实打实的赏...

say:9:1122109006:1.text: ... What are you saying? You implying I can't even capture a terrabird?!
say:9:1122109006:1.source_cn: ……你什么意思？是说我比你们都差呗？

say:10:1122109007:1.text: Alright, enough squabbling, you two! Continue guarding our base here.
say:10:1122109007:1.source_cn: 行了，别为这点小事争论个没完。你们两个，在这看守基地。

say:12:1122109008:1.text: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come with me. I know where we can find baby terrabirds.
say:12:1122109008:1.male: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come with me. I know where we can find baby terrabirds.
say:12:1122109008:1.female: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come with me. I know where we can find baby terrabirds.
